description: Deletes the webinar that belongs to this session from the connected WordPress site — irreversible, it cannot be undone: the campaign and everything attached to it are gone. Needs `session_id`; optional `args` names the campaign when the session holds more than one.

args.description: the arguments for that ability, shaped by its input_schema.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).
